<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Opposition protest:</strong> The INDIA bloc has announced a &quot;public impeachment&quot; of CEC Gyanesh Kumar on October 30 and a &quot;Dilli Chalo&quot; march for November 1 to protest against alleged irregularities in electoral roll management.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Judicial scrutiny:</strong> Former Justice Nariman has criticized the Election Commission for alleged &quot;malfunctions,&quot; urging the Supreme Court to expedite a ruling on the CEC Act to ensure institutional accountability.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiZkFVX3lxTE9KR2NWbllodDcxa1FIc0lmU25UcGlubU1TQjY5eWZHTmQ1WFR2VWx4OFA3ZmNGdTE2UExRNlFFaEZvN0Y1dFpPXzliNEVNLW1INkxpTm5YdFNpRDRtRWtLVUpYVEVFZw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Electoral transparency:</strong> The Election Commission has refused to disclose details regarding the software used in the Special Integrated Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls, citing &quot;trade secrets,&quot; even as it prepares to proceed with the process in Tamil Nadu.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a></span></li>
</ul>
